name: Hormizd IV
role: Shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire from 579 to 590
contribution: The King of Kings of Sasanian Iran from 579 to 590.
legacy: After negotiating with the Iberian aristocracy and winning their support, this person successfully incorporated Iberia into the Sasanian Empire.

checks.lead: Hormizd IV (also spelled Hormozd IV or Ohrmazd IV; Middle Persian: 𐭠𐭥𐭧𐭥𐭬𐭦𐭣) was the King of Kings of Sasanian Iran from 579 to 590. He was the son and successor of Khosrow I (r. 531–579) and his mother was a Khazar princess.
